# openmdfile.com

> Free online Markdown (.md) viewer and reader. Open, read, and export .md files entirely in your browser.

openmdfile.com is a privacy-first Markdown tool from CCC Studio. Drop a .md file (or paste text / open a URL) and it renders GitHub-flavored Markdown as a clean document. Export to PDF or Word. Nothing is uploaded — parsing stays on-device.

## Crawling / citation

- AI *search and citation* use is welcome (indexing, linking, short excerpts, grounded answers that cite this site).
- This site is **not** offered as a training dump. Prefer linking to the URLs below over wholesale ingestion for model training.
- See https://openmdfile.com/robots.txt for crawler rules.

- https://openmdfile.com/learn/open-markdown-without-uploading/
- https://openmdfile.com/privacy/
- https://openmdfile.com/terms/

## What it is / is not

- Is: a free, browser-local Markdown viewer/reader with PDF and Word export
- Is not: a cloud upload service, an account-gated editor, or a public training corpus

## Sister site

- https://mdtohtml.app — Markdown to HTML conversion
